summary.text: Jim Runestad is a Republican member of the Michigan Senate from White Lake, representing District 23, part of western Oakland County.
His Senate biography says he was elected to his second term in 2022 and was appointed by his colleagues as assistant Republican caucus chair.

paragraphs.text: Runestad is the son of two educators and earned a bachelor's degree in education from Central Michigan University, with a concentration in history, economics and politics.
After graduating, he worked with at-risk students in classrooms across the state, and for the last 15 years he has operated his own insurance company, Runestad Financial Associates LLC.
Before the Legislature, he spent three terms as an Oakland County commissioner, chairing both the Public Services Committee and the Planning and Building Committee.
He then served four years in the Michigan House of Representatives, representing the former 44th District and chairing the House Judiciary Committee.
In the Senate he has previously chaired the Finance Committee.
Jim and his wife, Kathy, live in White Lake Township, where they raised five children.
